actions.description: The Project Management Plan soundly integrates the subsidiary management plans (Scope, Risk, Quality, Communications, Resource, etc.), establishes valid baselines, and defines clear governance rules -- approve it to authorize drafting ADRs, BRDs, FDDs, and User Stories
The Project Management Plan has critical gaps, conflicting subsidiary plans, or ungrounded baseline assumptions -- reject it outright
The Project Management Plan requires reconciliation among subsidiary plans, clearer risk/quality thresholds, or unforced schedule/cost deferrals before authorization

metadata.decision_context: Given a drafted Project Management Plan and its integrated subsidiary plans, decide whether to approve it to authorize drafting technical requirements (ADR, BRD, FDD, Stories), reject it, or request revision before deciding

complexity_profile.rationale: Defaults to true for every policy in this template, learned from a real correction (ADPA's own approve-adr was first built with requires_human_approval: false, and the resolver's own execute_without_confirmation logic would have bypassed a real governance rule as a result). Correct this down per-policy only with real evidence the specific decision doesn't need a human sign-off -- never flip it the other direction speculatively.
